title: 2020 roadmap on pore materials for energy and environmental applications
claim: Introducing catalytic sites into carbon-aerogel scaffolds can couple contaminant adsorption with oxidative degradation or regeneration.
explanation: The review discusses supported metal species or nitrogen-doped carbon sites for activating oxidants and degrading adsorbates.
scope: Multifunctional carbon aerogels for environmental remediation.
conditions: Appropriate catalytic sites and oxidants must be present.
caveats: Prolonged oxidation can change pores and surfaces, while supported oxides may be unstable or leach metal ions.
